description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 19.08.2019 to 25.08.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous legal notification, making it clearly a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement.
